I visited this clinic in July last year for routine STD screening, along with my partner. Both of us received positive PCR results for HSV-2. This caused us a great deal of emotional distress and anxiety for over 8 months.

However, after repeating multiple IgG antibody tests months later, and getting PCR tests done at other reputable labs, we were told we were negative for HSV-2. We both have never shown symptoms, and our IgG results remained negative long after the initial diagnosis.

The most concerning part is that we were tested on different days, yet both received identical HSV-2 positive PCR results, which now seem highly questionable. We believe this may point to testing errors, mismanagement, or flawed procedures at the lab. Unfortunately, the clinic continues to insist the results were correct and refuses any accountability or refund.

This experience has caused serious psychological harm. We trusted this clinic with our health, and we feel that our trust was betrayed. I hope others will be cautious and consider double-checking results through more reliable institutions.
